label: Reconcile V3 positions
description: Compare the automation wallet's Pancake V3 NPM NFTs (`tokenOfOwnerByIndex`) to `alwaysOn.boundRows`: drop closed positions and report untracked. Same as Activity **Reconcile NFTs** (`CFS_V3_RECONCILE_POSITIONS`). Optional on always-on ticks; omit the step to skip.

inputs.description: Monitor workflow id whose boundRows to reconcile (default wf-bsc-v3-monitor).
When true, upsert untracked on-chain NFTs using primary-row policies.
On always-on SW ticks, run at most every N ticks (default 10). Tab playback always runs.

outputs.description: Row variable for JSON reconcile result (untrackedCount, closedCount).
